title: block_cache evict_for: O(N) count+sum query per eviction iteration — quadratic for full caches
description: block_cache.rs evict_for(): the loop re-runs 'SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(byte_size)' on every iteration. For a cache at max_entries with many blocks to evict, this is O(k) full-table scans where k is the number of entries evicted. With SQLite and 1M entries the query itself is fast, but it is unnecessary — the caller already knows incoming_bytes and can track a running total locally after reading the initial count+sum once, subtracting each evicted entry's byte_size as it goes.
